summary: Domino's Pizza filed an 8-K to announce the appointment of Michael C. Creedon Jr. and Anneliese Olson to its Board of Directors, effective July 15, 2026, increasing board size from eight to ten. Appointments were recommended by the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee; both will stand for re-election at the 2027 annual meeting. No departure or abrupt change occurred; this is a routine board expansion with standard director compensation. No special-situation event is present.
